name: USENIX Security Symposium
description: Major systems security and privacy conference with open access proceedings. Two submission cycles per year and shepherding process for papers requiring minor revisions.

peerReview.processDescription: Double-blind peer review with 100+ reviewers. Two submission cycles per year. Papers must include Ethical Considerations and Open Science appendices. Maximum 7 papers per author per cycle. Rebuttal period. Shepherding process.

attribution.attributionNotes: Published in USENIX proceedings (open access, citable). Internet Defense Prize (funded by Meta). Best Paper Awards. Speaker certificates. CPE credits.
